704216.t: From ἔκκλητος (ékklētos, “summoned”) + -ία (-ĭ́ā, abstract noun suffix), from ἐκκαλέω (ekkaléō, “to call forth, summon”), from ἐκ (ek) + καλέω (kaléō).

704240.t: From ἐκλέγω (eklégō, “to pick out”) + -τός (-tós, adjectival suffix).

704236.t: From ἐκ- (ek-, “out”) + λέγω (légō, “to choose”). Exact cognate in form and meaning to Latin ēligō (“to choose”).

704287.t: From ἐκ- (ek-, “out of”) + πλήσσω (plḗssō, “to strike, to smite”).

704252.t: From ἐκλύω (eklúō, “set free”) + -σις (-sis, “a suffix added to verb stems to form abstract nouns or nouns of action, result or process”)

704234.t: From ἐκλάμπω (eklắmpō, “to shine or beam forth”) + -σις (-sĭs, nominal suffix).

704233.t: From ἐκ- (ek-, “out, away, off”) + λάμπω (lắmpō, “to give light, shine”).

704271.t: From ἐκ- (ek-, “ex-, out-”) + παιδεύω (paideúō, “to raise, train”).
